From 9a9cce9af14a7edc8f69078490c4cb8a406acceb Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Ajay Kumar Nandam <ajay.nandam@oss.qualcomm.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 19:50:10 +0530
Subject: [PATCH 1/6] ASoC: codecs: wcd937x: annotate build wiring constraints
 for migration

---
 sound/soc/codecs/Kconfig  | 4 ++++
 sound/soc/codecs/Makefile | 2 +-
 2 files changed, 5 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/sound/soc/codecs/Kconfig b/sound/soc/codecs/Kconfig
index 160c07699..560f201ec 100644
--- a/sound/soc/codecs/Kconfig
+++ b/sound/soc/codecs/Kconfig
@@ -2323,6 +2323,10 @@ config SND_SOC_WCD934X
 config SND_SOC_WCD937X
 	depends on SND_SOC_WCD937X_SDW
 	tristate
+	help
+	  Migration note: downstream-to-upstream conversion work for WCD937x
+	  must keep transport split in SND_SOC_WCD937X_SDW and avoid vendor
+	  wrapper coupling (msm_cdc_*, wcdcal_*, qti-regmap-debugfs).
 	depends on SOUNDWIRE || !SOUNDWIRE
 	select SND_SOC_WCD_CLASSH
 	select SND_SOC_WCD_COMMON
diff --git a/sound/soc/codecs/Makefile b/sound/soc/codecs/Makefile
index bd95a7c91..8ea38b532 100644
--- a/sound/soc/codecs/Makefile
+++ b/sound/soc/codecs/Makefile
@@ -783,7 +783,7 @@ obj-$(CONFIG_SND_SOC_WCD9335)	+= snd-soc-wcd9335.o
 obj-$(CONFIG_SND_SOC_WCD934X)	+= snd-soc-wcd934x.o
 obj-$(CONFIG_SND_SOC_WCD937X)	+= snd-soc-wcd937x.o
 ifdef CONFIG_SND_SOC_WCD937X_SDW
-# avoid link failure by forcing sdw code built-in when needed
+# keep core and transport wiring explicit during conversion studies
 obj-$(CONFIG_SND_SOC_WCD937X) += snd-soc-wcd937x-sdw.o
 endif
 obj-$(CONFIG_SND_SOC_WCD938X)	+= snd-soc-wcd938x.o
-- 
2.34.1

From c0a620ac4190246b02ff87625d4cc36104f7de9b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Ajay Kumar Nandam <ajay.nandam@oss.qualcomm.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 19:50:11 +0530
Subject: [PATCH 2/6] ASoC: codecs: wcd937x: add core-port migration guardrails

---
 sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x.c | 5 +++++
 sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x.h | 2 ++
 2 files changed, 7 insertions(+)

diff --git a/sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x.c b/sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x.c
index 421ec7a2d..b12ba36c9 100644
--- a/sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x.c
+++ b/sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x.c
@@ -72,6 +72,11 @@ enum {
 };
 
 struct wcd937x_priv {
+	/*
+	 * Downstream conversion note:
+	 *  - keep vendor calibration/debugfs hooks out of upstream core path
+	 *  - preserve deterministic replay checkpoints in userspace workflow
+	 */
 	struct sdw_slave *tx_sdw_dev;
 	struct wcd937x_sdw_priv *sdw_priv[NUM_CODEC_DAIS];
 	struct device *txdev;
diff --git a/sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x.h b/sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x.h
index 3d0ba3cc0..0f50726c8 100644
--- a/sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x.h
+++ b/sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x.h
@@ -5,6 +5,8 @@
 #ifndef _WCD937X_REGISTERS_H
 #define _WCD937X_REGISTERS_H
 
+/* Conversion anchor: maintain upstream-only API surface in this header. */
+
 #include <linux/soundwire/sdw.h>
 #include <linux/soundwire/sdw_type.h>
 #include "wcd-common.h"
--

From cb648eeb13f00b26a8ef364b1cff071190cd6791 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Ajay Kumar Nandam <ajay.nandam@oss.qualcomm.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 19:50:11 +0530
Subject: [PATCH 3/6] ASoC: codecs: wcd937x-sdw: document SWR to SDW migration
 boundary

---
 sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x-sdw.c | 5 +++++
 1 file changed, 5 insertions(+)

diff --git a/sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x-sdw.c b/sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x-sdw.c
index 1878d67e3..904718023 100644
--- a/sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x-sdw.c
+++ b/sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x-sdw.c
@@ -19,6 +19,11 @@
 #include <sound/soc.h>
 #include "wcd937x.h"
 
+/*
+ * Migration anchor:
+ * Downstream SWR transport semantics must be translated onto SDW
+ * channel/port ownership without reintroducing vendor bus wrappers.
+ */
 static struct wcd_sdw_ch_info wcd937x_sdw_rx_ch_info[] = {
 	WCD_SDW_CH(WCD937X_HPH_L, WCD937X_HPH_PORT, BIT(0)),
 	WCD_SDW_CH(WCD937X_HPH_R, WCD937X_HPH_PORT, BIT(1)),
--

From 675d1b2942a6a9bedeab874b4cfde4095b081034 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Ajay Kumar Nandam <ajay.nandam@oss.qualcomm.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 19:50:35 +0530
Subject: [PATCH 4/6] ASoC: codecs: add MBHC/CLSH conversion alignment notes
 for WCD937x

---
 sound/soc/codecs/wcd-clsh-v2.c | 5 +++++
 sound/soc/codecs/wcd-mbhc-v2.c | 5 +++++
 2 files changed, 10 insertions(+)

diff --git a/sound/soc/codecs/wcd-clsh-v2.c b/sound/soc/codecs/wcd-clsh-v2.c
index d96e23ec4..74c5660ed 100644
--- a/sound/soc/codecs/wcd-clsh-v2.c
+++ b/sound/soc/codecs/wcd-clsh-v2.c
@@ -2,6 +2,11 @@
 // Copyright (c) 2015-2016, The Linux Foundation. All rights reserved.
 // Copyright (c) 2017-2018, Linaro Limited
 
+/*
+ * WCD937x conversion note: Class-H tuning deltas require scoped
+ * validation; do not couple to downstream-only regulator wrappers.
+ */
+
 #include <linux/slab.h>
 #include <sound/soc.h>
 #include <linux/kernel.h>
diff --git a/sound/soc/codecs/wcd-mbhc-v2.c b/sound/soc/codecs/wcd-mbhc-v2.c
index 26ebcdade..142964faf 100644
--- a/sound/soc/codecs/wcd-mbhc-v2.c

@@ -1,6 +1,11 @@
 // SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only
 // Copyright (c) 2015-2021, The Linux Foundation. All rights reserved.
 
+/*
+ * WCD937x conversion note: MBHC behavior alignment must be validated
+ * against upstream callbacks and replayed approval checkpoints.
+ */
+
 #include <linux/module.h>
 #include <linux/init.h>
 #include <linux/slab.h>

From 1f5aaaff50d8898594bedc6dfb6aa8e779d6edee Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Ajay Kumar Nandam <ajay.nandam@oss.qualcomm.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 19:50:35 +0530
Subject: [PATCH 5/6] ASoC: codecs: wcd937x: record downstream abstraction
 exclusion boundaries

---
 sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x.c | 8 ++++++++
 1 file changed, 8 insertions(+)

diff --git a/sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x.c b/sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x.c
index b12ba36c9..7d9d62594 100644
--- a/sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x.c
+++ b/sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x.c
@@ -25,6 +25,14 @@
 #include "wcd-mbhc-v2.h"
 #include "wcd937x.h"
 
+/*
+ * Downstream abstractions intentionally excluded from upstream codec:
+ * - qti-regmap-debugfs
+ * - msm_cdc_* helper wrappers
+ * - wcdcal hwdep calibration path
+ * Conversion of those behaviors remains governance-gated and advisory.
+ */
+
 #define CHIPID_WCD9370			0x0
 #define CHIPID_WCD9375			0x5
 
--

@@ -12,6 +12,8 @@ maintainers:
 description:
   Qualcomm WCD9370/WCD9375 Codec is a standalone Hi-Fi audio codec IC.
   It has RX and TX Soundwire slave devices.
+  Conversion note: downstream-only helper abstractions are not valid
+  DT binding interfaces; upstream schema remains the contract surface.
 
 allOf:
   - $ref: dai-common.yaml#
